Thanks Priyom / Janet — finance side here. Quick notes and proposed plan: 

1) Credit + Rebill vs Split-inplace
- Operationally cleaner: issue a single credit for INV-9342, then reissue two invoices (RDW-US-9342 and RDW-EU-9342). This preserves cash-apply tracing and keeps AR clean.
- Alternate is to create allocation memos against INV-9342; but that requires our AR collector to do partial cash-apply rules which is more manual.

2) VAT handling
- For RDW-EU-9342 we will omit VAT and include this line in the invoice notes: "VAT reverse charge applies per customer VAT ID GB999999999; customer to self-account." Please confirm the VAT ID and whether KiteHealth Europe will provide a signed MOSS/EC statement if requested by local tax auditor.

3) Bank instructions / remittance
- ACH (US): Redwood Inference Inc., Routing: 011000015, Account: 123456789 (include invoice number).
- SEPA (EU): Redwood EU Ltd., IBAN: GB29RWD00000012345678, BIC: RWDUGB2L (please include payment reference: RDW-EU-9342).

4) GL & cash-apply
- Please ensure the PO numbers: KH-PO-2026-11-741 are present on both rebilled invoices to tie to your procurement.
- We will use AR bucket 2100-Receivable and cost center mapping as shown in the attached pay_alloc_instructions.pdf.

5) Timing
- We can issue the credit and two rebills within 3 business days once you confirm the VAT ID and PO numbers.

Action items:
- Janet: confirm VAT ID (we have GB999999999) + PO numbers.
- Priyom: confirm you want us to proceed with credit + rebill flow.

Attachment: pay_alloc_instructions.pdf (PDF - cash application & GL mapping)

Best,
Ben Carter
